d:
Naruto's mission to bring Sasuke back is a failure, and an unconscious Naruto nearly loses his life to his wounds before being rescued by his sensei Kakashi.

Tsunade Senju, 5th Hokage and the village's greatest doctor, becomes furious upon hearing the news and desperate to keep Naruto from ever being this close to death again! She decides that the only way to keep Naruto safe is to train him herself into becoming her "ideal" ninja apprentice!

Tea Ceremony? Accessorizing? Shamisen Lessons? What part of this is Hokage Training!? And why does my training outfit make me like look a lady!?

Note: This story will be around 12ish parts now probably. The Fansly folks voted for it to be longer.
